title: デビュー戦の後に・宵の狭間に

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly after finishing her debut race, Mejiro Ardan senses the signs of a new beginning for herself, only to collapse from exhaustion moments later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although a medical examination finds no significant issues with her health, Mejiro Ardan is taken to the Mejiro family's rest house to recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reason for her collapse is determined to be the simultaneous post-race manifestation of accumulated stress and fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mejiro family's chief physician advises that she withdraw from racing and recuperate for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Mejiro Ardan's trainer, I find myself pressured with a difficult decision…
